newsitem.title: HONG KONG: NWI to take stake in Macau utilities.
newsitem.headline: NWI to take stake in Macau utilities.

text.p: New World Infrastructure Ltd said on Monday it had agreed in principle to buy a 50 percent stake in Sino-French Holdings (Hong Kong) Ltd which owns interests in Macau's electricity and water supply companies.
The price of the acquisition from Chow Tai Fook Enterprises Ltd had yet to be finalised, New World Infrastructure said in a statement.
Chow Tai Fook had a 34.99 percent stake in New World Infrastructure parent New World Development Co Ltd as of April 1997.

Sino-French Holdings owns a 40.5 percent effective stake in Companhia de Electricidade de Macau SARL and 85 percent of Sociedade de Abastecimento de Aguas de Macau SARL. It also has interests in a number of water plants in China.
Lyonnaise des Eaux SA holds a 26 percent stake in Sino-French and Lyonnaise Asia Water Ltd has a 24 percent stake.
New World Infrastructure said the agreement in principle was not legally binding.
